_meta.authority: NIDHINETRA-DESIGN-BRIEF.md sections 4, 5, 10, 11, 12. PRD section 4. Execution Plan section 3.2.
_meta.rule: No user-visible string exists anywhere except this file. A2 selects a template_id and supplies params. A4 passes both through. A5 renders. No agent writes prose.
_meta.scope: User-visible text only. Code identifiers, log lines, docstrings, test names and document titles are out of scope.
_meta.casing: Strings are stored in sentence case. Uppercase micro labels get their casing from text-transform in CSS, never from this file.
_meta.amendment: Raise with A6, land it here, append to Logbook.md. Never patch copy inside a component.
amendment_log: 2026-09-03: added detail_panel.breakdown_ensemble, .breakdown_ensemble_note and .breakdown_capped. The panel's risk breakdown previously divided risk_score evenly across the fired flags, which misstated the engine: rank.py weights them 30/25/25/20 and adds a separate ensemble component. Itemising the real weights leaves a remainder that needed a label, and a capped total needed a note. No existing string changed.

2026-09-03: reference-fidelity pass against Precision and research first/NidhiNetra.dc.html. Changed framing.premise and summary_strip.value_under_flagged/.idle_beyond_12_months to match the reference's exact wording (the second was also a real accuracy fix: idle_beyond_12_months sums sanctioned_amount_inr, and 'released, unspent' names that field correctly where 'idle' did not). Changed table.columns.agency from 'Agency' to 'Implementing agency' -- the fuller form already existed as column_tooltips.agency, now promoted to the visible header too. Added table.columns.days_stale and column_tooltips.days_stale for a column the reference has and the app did not. Added table.filtered_summary, a new sentence replacing quota_meter's bar-and-caption UI on the Inspection List: the reference has no bar, only this line, computed from the same real quota figures the bar used. Added nav.org_label, the ministry name the reference shows in a top bar above the title on every page; also corrected nav._note's path to the reference file, which had gone stale.

2026-09-03: added fund_flow.concentration_filter_label/.concentration_filter_description/.min_members_label/.show_non_matching/.hide_non_matching/.cluster_in_focus_label/.cluster_members/.cluster_works/.cluster_paid/.cluster_median_note/.member_singular/.member_plural for the Fund Flow view's threshold filter and cluster-in-focus panel, both new. Deliberately no 'Districts' figure: the reference's mockup shows one, but build_graph.py's own docstring says the graph carries no separate district node, and MP nodes are keyed by mp_name, not constituency -- a Districts count is not honestly computable from this schema without joining in the inspection list's rows, which this pass does not do. Named, not faked.

2026-09-04: added fund_flow.drawn_cap_note. Rung 1 landed 79,068 real works, and the Fund Flow view's threshold filter -- correct at fixture scale -- matched 4,845 of 16,854 vendors at national scale, rendering 5,695 SVG nodes in a 164,778px-tall graph. A graph that exists to surface concentration surfaces nothing at that size. The view now draws only the most concentrated clusters and says so, rather than silently truncating or rendering something unreadable.

2026-09-05: added inspection_capture, for Checkpoints CP8's on-screen recording of an inspection outcome. outcome_options mirrors the six-value enum in contracts/inspection_outcome.schema.json exactly (frozen the same eng-review session, see NEXT-STEPS.md item 4) -- every key here must match an enum value there, and neither list may drift from the other. No option reads as a verdict: no fraud, clean, verified or confirmed anywhere in this block, per lint.banned_literal.

2026-09-05: added inspection_capture.control_sample_label, same session, after an outside-voice review pass found CP8's precision-at-quota metric had no real comparison group (nothing is ever inspected outside the ranked list, so 'outside cutoff' would always be empty). This checkbox is how an officer marks an inspection as a deliberate random check rather than one from the ranked recommendation.

2026-09-05: added inspection_capture.inspector_id_label, same session, second outside-voice pass: the enum schema had no way to say WHICH reviewer recorded an outcome, quietly breaking the deck's own 'reviewers train the model' (plural) claim. No auth exists in this prototype, so this is self-reported initials, not a verified identity -- still required, so inter-rater disagreement is at least visible instead of invisible.

2026-09-11: redesign against the user's pinned reference (NidhiNetra_Vidhi.png). Added brand, dashboard, quota_card, view_options, presenter, pagination, search, specimen, reports and system_pages, and extended nav, filters, table, detail_panel and fund_flow. Changed table.columns.district from 'District' to 'Constituency': the column always showed the constituency and the source has no district field. Changed summary_strip.idle_beyond_12_months from 'Released, unspent beyond twelve months' to 'Sanctioned, unspent beyond twelve months': the figure sums sanctioned_amount_inr, and nothing in the source says the money was released. Changed table.column_tooltips.days_stale to say what last_updated actually is. The reference's 'across every district, every scheme, every citizen' was not adopted: this product covers one scheme, MPLADS.

2026-09-11: fund_flow.cluster_paid 'Paid' became 'Sanctioned value' and fund_flow.edge_label now ends in 'sanctioned': build_graph.py sums sanctioned_amount_inr onto every edge, so 'Paid' overstated what the figure is (ultra-review F10). Added filters.panel_label and detail_panel.source_labels (rung 1 is the MPLADS public dashboard pull; other rungs keep their number until they have agreed copy).

2026-09-12: removed the specimen sheet as a nav-reachable page and its whole string block (design brief section 4 material: type scale, swatches, elevation, shape, component samples). It was a live token inspector for development, not a product view for officers or judges; the user asked for it out of the shipped frontend. Four real tabs remain: Dashboard, Inspection list, Fund flow, Reports. nav.specimen is removed rather than left unused.

2026-09-14: added entity_alias_review for R-06's Fund Flow review queue. The copy presents ambiguous vendor-ID/name associations as records that may refer to the same company, keeps evidence work IDs visible, and uses the design-reviewed actions 'These are the same' / 'These are different'. No review is described as a verified identity decision.

2026-09-16: F-01. Added detail_panel.record_fields.district_authority and missing_fields.district_authority: the work record now shows the District Authority (IDA_NAME) and the Implementing agency (IA_NAME) as two fields instead of one mislabelled field. Added fund_flow.rebuild_required_title and .rebuild_required_body for the state where the API holds back a graph built before that split or before its edges carried work IDs.

2026-09-17: Phase 0. Added detail_panel.record_fields.work_description, .activity and .recommendation_date, and missing_fields.description. The portal publishes a description, an activity string and a recommendation date on every work; the pipeline dropped all three. They are shown as published, with only transport spacing tidied, and nothing about them is derived or interpreted.

2026-09-17: Phase 0 follow-up. detail_panel.record_fields.work_description is now 'Portal description', matching 'Portal activity', so the text under the title says where it comes from. missing_fields.description is now 'Description not recorded', in the same form as the other missing values: until the snapshot is rebuilt it holds no description column, and the earlier sentence would have told the officer the portal published nothing for works where it did.

_measure.note: 46ch is the wrap measure from --measure-reason in design brief B1. It is not a truncation cap. The two reference examples in Execution Plan 3.2 are 53 and 52 characters and both wrap to two lines, so two lines is the intended normal.
_measure.rule: A template passes if its render at the declared maximum parameter lengths is 92 characters or fewer.

_rules: State the measurement. Never state the inference.
Every reason carries at least one number, because the product promise in design brief section 1 is 'here is exactly why'.
Every reason ends in a full stop, matching both reference examples.
No verb of judgement. The reference examples use 'is' and 'recorded'.
Where a dash is wanted, use a comma. The reference example 'Sanctioned 14 months ago, zero expenditure recorded.' already demonstrates this.

default.text: Cost is {multiple}x the median for {category} works in this state.
default.use_when: Always, in the table reason line. This is the reference example from Execution Plan 3.2.

named_state.text: Cost is {multiple}x the median for {category} works in {state}.
named_state.use_when: Detail panel only, where the measure is wider and the state may not be on screen.
named_state.caution: Do not use for states whose display name exceeds 20 characters. See number_format.state_display.

no_multiple.text: Cost is above the usual range for {category} works here.
no_multiple.use_when: The peer median is unavailable or zero, so a multiple cannot be computed honestly.

zero_spend.text: Sanctioned {months} months ago, zero expenditure recorded.
zero_spend.use_when: Expenditure is exactly zero. This is the reference example from Execution Plan 3.2.

part_spend.use_when: Expenditure is above zero but below the stall threshold.

no_update.use_when: sanction_date is missing but last_updated is present. Never render a missing sanction date as a computed age.

amounts.use_when: Detail panel, where the absolute figures are more useful than the ratio.

full_spend_open.text: Full amount spent, work still under implementation.
full_spend_open.use_when: expenditure equals sanction while completion_status is not Completed.

mps.text: Agency holds works from {mp_count} different MPs.

districts_and_mps.text: Agency holds works in {district_count} districts, {mp_count} MPs.
districts_and_mps.use_when: Both spans are unusual and the fund flow view is reachable from this row.

vendor.text: Vendor appears in {district_count} districts this year.
vendor.use_when: The concentrated node is a vendor rather than an implementing agency.

share.text: Agency holds {percent_share} percent of works in this district.
share.use_when: Share of a single district rather than a span across many.

agency_concentration._note: Neutral verb is 'holds'. 'Controls', 'dominates', 'captured', 'cornered' and 'monopolises' are banned. See lint.banned_derived.

peer_group._note: Design brief section 4 requires real visual weight here, not a caption. Two forms exist in the source documents; both are frozen with a stated rule for which to use.

contextual.text: Compared against {peer_n} {category} works in this state for this year.
contextual.use_when: Table row and detail panel, where the active state and year filters are already on screen.

explicit.use_when: Anywhere the state and year are not otherwise visible, and in any exported or screenshotted view.
explicit.source: PRD must-ship item M3, verbatim form.

thin.text: Compared against {peer_n} {category} works, a small group.
thin.use_when: peer_n is below 30. Saying the group is small is an honesty requirement, not a hedge.

peer_group.label: Peer group
peer_group.missing: Peer group not available for this work.

risk_labels._source: Design brief B2, the comments on the --risk-0 through --risk-4 tokens.
risk_labels.score_caption: An ordering device, not a likelihood.
risk_labels._note: Level 0 is 'Not currently flagged' and never 'Clear', 'Clean', 'OK' or 'Verified'. Design brief section 6: nothing here is verified clean, only unflagged.

framing.premise: District Authorities must physically inspect at least ten percent of works under implementation every year. This ranks the works by risk, so that ten percent is chosen rather than assumed.
framing.premise_note: Title block sentence. The 46ch reason measure does not apply here; --measure-reason governs .t-reason only.
framing.standing_note: Flags are recommendations to inspect, not findings.
framing.standing_note_placement: Persistent, below the table, in muted ink. Not a modal, not a dismissible banner.
framing.unflagged_caveat: Unflagged does not mean inspected or verified.

summary_strip._note: Design brief section 4 names these four figures. Originally specified to render in crore for at-a-glance comparison (number_format.currency.summary_strip_override); reversed 2026-09-02 per direct request -- full rupee amounts, Indian-grouped, no abbreviation, so two figures can be compared exactly rather than approximately. See lib/format.ts formatCurrencyFull.

column_tooltips.days_stale: Days since this record was last updated in the source data

table.filtered_summary: {total_n} works are under implementation in this filter. The ten percent obligation falls at rank {cutoff_rank}. Ranks 1 to {shown_n} are shown, ordered by risk score.
table.filtered_summary_short: {total_n} works are under implementation in this filter. The ten percent obligation falls at rank {cutoff_rank}.
table.rank_order_hint: Ranked by risk score, highest first

detail_panel.title: Work record
detail_panel.breakdown_ensemble_note: A supporting signal, not one of the four named flags. It only adjusts position around them.
detail_panel.breakdown_capped: Flags contribute at most {cap} points in total. Each line above shows the share that reached the score.

fund_flow.title: Fund flow
fund_flow.subtitle: MPs, implementing agencies and vendors. Edges are money.
fund_flow.empty_body: Widen the filter or select a different agency.
fund_flow.rebuild_required_title: This view is waiting for a data rebuild.
fund_flow.rebuild_required_body: The fund-flow data on disk was built before implementing agencies and supporting work IDs were recorded separately. It is held back rather than shown under the wrong labels.
fund_flow.scale_caveat: Concentration patterns are only meaningful across many districts.
fund_flow.concentration_filter_description: Showing vendors paid on works recommended by {threshold} or more Members of Parliament. {matching} of {total} vendors in this filter match. Everything else is held back so the cluster reads.
fund_flow.show_non_matching: Show the vendors that do not match
fund_flow.hide_non_matching: Hide the vendors that do not match
fund_flow.cluster_median_note: The median vendor in this filter is paid on works from {median} {member_word}.
fund_flow.drawn_cap_note: Drawing the {drawn} most concentrated. Raise the minimum to narrow further.
fund_flow.clusters_note: Ranked by how many Members of Parliament recommended the works each vendor is paid on.
fund_flow.deep_link_title: Fund flow for one implementing agency
fund_flow.back_to_clusters: Back to the most concentrated vendors

entity_alias_review.title: Vendor records to review
entity_alias_review.body: These vendor records may refer to the same company. Check the linked works before recording a decision.

reason.identifier_has_multiple_labels: This vendor ID appears with more than one name.
reason.label_has_multiple_identifiers: This vendor name appears under more than one vendor ID.
reason.identifier_and_label_ambiguous: This vendor ID has more than one name, and this name appears under more than one vendor ID.

entity_alias_review.reviewer_note: Review decisions use the self-reported initials kept on this device.
entity_alias_review.empty_title: No vendor records are waiting for review.
entity_alias_review.empty_body: New candidates appear when a data snapshot contains an ambiguous vendor identity.
entity_alias_review.error_title: Could not load vendor records for review.
entity_alias_review.error_body: The fund-flow graph is still available. Retry the review queue.
entity_alias_review.save_error: Could not save this review decision. Try again.

actions._note: PRD section 4: buttons say 'Flag for inspection', never 'Report fraud'. 'Investigate', 'Report' and 'Escalate' are banned as button verbs.

loading.render: Skeleton rows matching the real row geometry. Design brief section 11: never a spinner.
loading.never: Do not render a visible 'Loading...' label, a spinner, a progress percentage or a time estimate.

empty_after_filter.title: No works match these filters.
empty_after_filter.body: Widen the state, year or category filter.
empty_after_filter.render: Composed in the table body at the same measure as a reason line, not centred in a large void.
empty_after_filter.never: Do not write 'No issues found', 'All clear', 'Nothing to report' or 'You are all caught up'. Design brief section 10 bans 'No issues' by name.

no_flags_variant.use_when: The filter returns works, but none of them are flagged. Distinct from returning no works at all.
no_flags_variant.title: No works in this filter are currently flagged.
no_flags_variant.body: Unflagged does not mean inspected or verified.

api_unreachable.title: Cannot reach the data service.
api_unreachable.body: Check that the service is running, then retry.
api_unreachable.render: Replaces the table body. The filter bar and summary strip stay in place so the officer keeps their context.
api_unreachable.never: No 'Oops', no 'Something went wrong', no exclamation mark, no stack trace, no HTTP status code in the visible text. Log the status code instead.
api_unreachable.precedence: If a cached snapshot is available, render showing_cached_data instead of this state.

showing_cached_data.label: Offline. Showing snapshot from {date}.
showing_cached_data.detail: {record_count} records. No live connection in use.
showing_cached_data.render: A single muted line above the filter bar. Provenance, not decoration.
showing_cached_data.note: Design brief section 12 bans version stamps and locale strips as decoration. This line is functional provenance required by PRD M6 and CP6, and is not covered by that ban.

demo_dataset_variant.use_when: source_rung is 5, the hand-curated seed dataset.
demo_dataset_variant.label: Demo dataset. Not live MPLADS data.
demo_dataset_variant.detail: Curated from published reports for demonstration.
demo_dataset_variant.render: Same position, but always visible and never dismissible.
demo_dataset_variant.authority: Execution Plan section 2, rung 5: clearly labelled in the UI as a demo dataset. Honest labelling is mandatory.

refresh_in_progress.label: Refreshing. Showing the previous results.
refresh_in_progress.render: The existing table stays fully visible and readable. A muted label in the filter bar only.
refresh_in_progress.never: Do not blank the table, do not overlay a scrim, do not show a spinner, do not disable the filters.

refresh_failed.label: Refresh failed. Showing results from {time}.
refresh_failed.body: The previous results are still on screen.
refresh_failed.render: The stale table stays. The label sits where refresh_in_progress sat.
refresh_failed.never: Do not clear the table on a failed refresh. Stale data with an honest timestamp beats an empty screen.

missing_fields._authority: Design brief section 11: vendor unknown, date absent, amount not yet recorded.
missing_fields.render: Muted ink, one step down, left aligned even inside a numeric column, because it is text and not a number.
missing_fields.never: A missing amount never renders as zero, as a dash, or as N/A. Rendering a missing amount as zero would make stalled_work appear to fire on absent data.

grouping.authority: Design brief section 5: All rupee amounts use Indian numbering. Write 1,72,961 and not 172,961. Getting this wrong reads as a foreign product built by people who did not check.
grouping.applies_to: Every integer on screen, including counts and peer_n, not only currency.

currency.trailing_zeros: Always kept, never trimmed. A right aligned column of tabular figures breaks visually if the decimal count varies between rows.
currency.integer_part: The integer part keeps Indian grouping inside the compact form. Write 1,729.61 Cr and not 1729.61 Cr.
currency.summary_strip_override: All four summary figures render in crore regardless of magnitude, so the four values compare directly.
currency.prose_form: Inside a sentence, spell the unit: 12.40 lakh, 1,729.61 crore. Abbreviate to L and Cr only in table cells, the summary strip and the detail panel.
currency.never_zero_for_missing: A null amount renders missing_fields.amount. Never ₹0.

multiple.over_100: Round to a whole number, for example 140x. One decimal at that magnitude is false precision.
multiple.authority: Execution Plan 3.2 reference example: Cost is 3.2x the median.
multiple.never: Do not write 3x for a value of 3.0. Do not write 3.24x. Do not put a space before the x.

percent.in_numeric_columns: Use the symbol with no space.
percent.authority: The design brief writes 10 percent, 38 percent and 90 percent in prose throughout.

risk_score.never: Never append a percent sign. Never label it confidence, probability, likelihood or accuracy. It orders a queue, it does not estimate a chance.
risk_score.authority: PRD section 4: Explainability beats accuracy theatre.

rank.never: No hash symbol, no 'Rank 1' inside the cell.
rank.authority: Design brief section 4: Rank is narrow, fixed width, tabular numerals, muted. It orders the page; it does not shout.

date.never: Never 12/08/2026 or 08/12/2026. A slash date is ambiguous between Indian and American order.
date.financial_year: 2023-24, plain hyphen. Never an en dash, never an em dash.

time.note: 24 hour, IST, no seconds, no timezone suffix in the interface.

category_phrase._note: Categories arrive from contract 3.1 in title case. Mid-sentence they render lowercase from this map. A1 extends the map when the real category list lands; unmapped values fall back to lowercasing the raw value.

state_display.rule: Use the official state name as it arrives from contract 3.1.
state_display.open_item: Two union territory names exceed 20 characters and have no agreed short form here. A1 confirms the official abbreviation before the named_state variant is used for them. Until then those rows use the default variant.

tabular.rule: Every rendered number sits in a tabular figure font. No exception.
tabular.authority: Design brief section 12 do-not-ship list: Any number without tabular figures.

lint._note: validate.py reads this block so the rules and the strings have one source of truth. Scope is this file plus text nodes in web/components. It does not scan code identifiers, log lines, docstrings, test names or markdown documents.

banned_chars._why_escaped: Stored as escapes so this config file never contains the character it bans, and a repo wide grep for the em dash has no permanent false positive in its own rule file.

negation_exemptions: Flags are recommendations to inspect, not findings.
Unflagged does not mean inspected or verified.
An ordering device, not a likelihood.
lint._negation_note: Found by running this lint against this file. A banned word used to deny a claim is the opposite of an overclaim, and these three strings are among the most load bearing in the product. Exempt them by exact whole string match, never by relaxing the word rule, so a new negated phrase has to be added here deliberately.

structural.no_uppercase_only_strings: Casing is presentation. Store sentence case.

inspection_capture._authority: Checkpoints CP8. An inspection outcome is an observed fact, never a verdict -- see lint.banned_literal for fraud/clean/verified/confirmed and why they are banned everywhere, including here.

outcome_options.work_present_and_matches: Work exists and matches the record
outcome_options.work_present_but_differs: Work exists but differs from the record
outcome_options.work_not_found_at_site: No work found at the site

inspection_capture.control_sample_label: This is a random spot-check, not from the ranked list
inspection_capture.error_duplicate: An inspection for this work and date is already recorded.
inspection_capture.error_stale_work: This work is not in the current data. Refresh the page and try again.
inspection_capture.never: No outcome option may read as a verdict. Never fraud, clean, verified or confirmed -- see lint.banned_literal. No model retraining is implied anywhere in this copy -- Checkpoints CP8: no model changes in this checkpoint.

nav._note: New 2026-09-02: the app had no way to reach /fund-flow except a specific work row link. The Claude Design reference (Precision and research first/NidhiNetra.dc.html -- corrected 2026-09-03, an earlier path here was stale) had INSPECTION LIST / FUND FLOW / SPECIMEN SHEET as top-level tabs; this adds the two that exist as real views. Specimen Sheet is the design brief's own type/spacing/colour specimen page (design brief section 4), not a product view -- not built, not added here, rather than inventing a third view with no product spec behind it. 2026-09-11: all five of the reference's tabs are now real views, by the user's decision: Dashboard, Inspection list, Fund flow, Specimen sheet (the live design system, read from the same tokens the pages use) and Reports (recorded inspections).
nav.org_label: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
nav.officer_body: Self-reported and kept on this device. They are attached to inspections you record. Sign-in is not part of this prototype.

brand._note: Identity and context marks from the pinned reference (NidhiNetra_Vidhi.png, 2026-09-11). Hindi strings render with lang="hi". The State Emblem is not used: the State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act, 2005 restricts it.
brand.name: NidhiNetra
brand.ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
brand.logo_alt: NidhiNetra logo, a tricolour eye with the Ashoka Chakra as its iris
brand.tagline: A closer look. A stronger India.
brand.hero_body: Transparent monitoring. Accountable implementation. Every MPLADS work under implementation, ranked for inspection.
brand.footer_credit: Built for the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
brand.footer_tagline: Data for people. Progress for India.

dashboard.kpi_works_context: Across {constituency_n} constituencies in {state_n} states and union territories
dashboard.kpi_value_share: {percent} percent of all value sanctioned under implementation
dashboard.kpi_idle_context: {work_n} works sanctioned over a year ago with zero expenditure recorded

quota_card.bar_label: {quota_n} of {total_n} works fall inside the ten percent quota.
quota_card.explainer: The bar is all {total_n} works under implementation in this filter, ordered by risk score. The filled segment is the ten percent minimum to inspect this year: {quota_n} works.
quota_card.overflow: A further {flagged_beyond_n} flagged works rank past the cutoff.
quota_card.underfill: Only {flagged_n} works in this filter carry a flag. The rest of the quota is ranked by the statistical pattern alone.
quota_card.none_flagged: No work in this filter carries a flag. The quota is ranked by the statistical pattern alone.

presenter._note: Presenter mode (?present=1) is a demo device, confirmed with the user 2026-09-11. It never appears in the officer's default interface.
presenter.data_state_note: Previews the designed loading and empty screens. The data does not change.

reports.title: Reports
reports.lede: Inspections recorded against this list, and how often each group observed an issue on site.
reports.within_quota: {n} inside the quota at the time
reports.not_enough: Shown after {need} inspections that reached the work. {have} so far.
reports.comparison_waiting: The comparison appears once both groups have {need} inspections that reached the work.
reports.comparison_ready: Issues were observed at {ranked} percent of ranked inspections and {spot} percent of spot-checks.
reports.method: An issue is any outcome other than the work existing and matching the record. Agency did not provide access is left out, because the work was not seen. Ranges are 95 percent Wilson intervals. Spot-checks are marked by the officer when recording; a pre-assigned random sample is not built yet.
reports.empty_body: Open any work from the inspection list and choose Record inspection. Each saved outcome appears here.

system_pages.not_found_title: There is no page at this address.
system_pages.not_found_body: The link may be old, or the address mistyped.
system_pages.error_body: Reload the page. If it happens again, check that the data service is running.
